items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Well, no, I never heard Buddy, but I heard a lot of talk about him.

ctx.x: Now, did you ever hear Buddy Bowling?
Well, no, I never heard Buddy, but I heard a lot of talk about him. Mm-hmm. But, I never heard him, but I heard a lot of talk about him.
Well, I think he had Frankie Dooson for a while. And I think Frankie Barty, motherly, I think that's what Fess told me.
